Historically the City Bank-Farmers Trust Building, Twenty Exchange, one of New York City's most iconic towers has been reborn as a landmarked luxury property. 20 Exchange Place, designed by Cross & Cross, was constructed in 1931 as the City Bank Farmers Trust Building.
